{{Top|leg}}
'''Gun emplacements'''<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref> were placed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by the [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|desert stormtrooper]] unit [[Desert Sands]] under the orders of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] around the time of the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]], largely to deal with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] in the area.<ref name="NP">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], when trying to find [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and later travel to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], had to evade their constant barrages in [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|his landspeeder]].<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref>
